reviews.comment: He's ok. Course is pretty disorganized honestly, but he at least teaches the concepts in a way that's understandable and practical, not super derivation heavy. MCQ & FRQ exams, weighted 20/80 roughly. He makes a lot of mistakes in class and designs “trick questions” on exams, but the exams were usually straightforward. Attendance is mandatory & 5%.

Professor Reeves is a very nice guy. Controls is a hard class. Exams were easy compared to long homeworks. Dr. Reeves speeds through lecture and the course material is somewhat disorganized. I didn't even know we had textbook readings until the week of the final, which would have really helped. Recorded lecture is very nice.

Dr. Reeves is a funny guy but it seems that he makes certain topics more complicated at times. Tests are open code and 1 cheat sheet to bring. He likes to allude to what's on the exam without flat out telling you which is sometimes annoying but is a great guy who cares a lot. Grades fair and records his lectures which is useful to rewatch.

Dr. Reeves is a fine professor, he is clear in explaining concepts and I like how he structures his lectures to include time to work in groups to break up the lecture. I will say he is disorganized and does not stick to his lecture schedule/timing which can make the class seem disjointed. Exams are very doable with high averages.
Nice guy who goes into depth about topics while providing good examples. Chill first exam and final but the second exam definitely killed a lot people. Overall very solid and replies fast.
Reeves pretends to be caring, but he hates to see the class do well. Get ready to teach yourself half of the course material from his 10 year old youtube videos.

Dr. Reeves was a solid prof. He gives clear expectations at the beginning of the semester and sticks with that. Homework is tricky, but he's helpful during office hours. Exams are tough, but he curves the exams accordingly so that exam averages are between 70 and 80. Just work hard and use your resources and office hours and his class is doable.
